name: @sos-2/api
description: SOS 2.0 Live API Service (Work Order P2): a plain Node + TypeScript service implementing @sos-2/api-contracts over @sos-2/live-store ports — mission/system-state/evidence/task/body-lease reads+writes, the observation event ingestion endpoint (with replay protection), and the health endpoint reporting per-provider availability as typed UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE when unconfigured. Zero vendor framework (node:http + repo-standard ESM + tsc build); the ROUTER is a pure request/response function (framework-independent, hostable later in Vercel functions or an external worker boundary WITHOUT contract change); NO long-running work inside request lifetimes (every handler is one bounded store operation); all clocks/ports/stores are injected (deterministic core; the CLI entry is the single composition root). Test-only workspace devDependencies (@sos-2/mission, @sos-2/system-state, @sos-2/evidence) exist solely to mint VALID domain records for contract fixtures; runtime dependencies are exactly @sos-2/api-contracts + @sos-2/live-store.
